module_dispositions.rationale: Defines the shared if_test and fi_or_else command classes exercised by conditional dispatch.
Defines frozen_fi among the permanent eqtb identities; its conditional use is exercised by §§493–510 and cross-referenced to tex82.input.outer-validity-recovery.
Defines and registers all seventeen TeX82 conditional predicate operands.
Provides print_cmd_chr spellings for predicate command codes already classified by §487.
Defines the independent condition stack, current limit, kind, and source-line state.
Initializes the empty condition-stack representation defined by §489.
Registers fi, or, and else in the shared fi_or_else command class and freezes fi for recovery.
Provides print_cmd_chr spellings for delimiter command codes already classified by §491.
Defines pass_text scanner scope, nested-condition counting, delimiter stopping, and skip-line tracking.
Defines push, pop, and identity-specific limit changes across recursive conditional evaluation.
Defines true/false branch selection and the nested-frame-sensitive false-limb skip.
Dispatches all seventeen TeX82 predicates, including mode, inner, stream, and constant state queries, to their canonical evaluators.
Tracing-only display of an already computed boolean; it adds no independent conditional transition.
Defines integer and dimension comparison scanning, relation selection, and missing-relation recovery.
Defines void, hbox, and vbox tests over a scanned box register.
Defines expanded character/category comparison and raw meaning/token-list comparison for ifx.
Defines ifcase limb selection and legal, premature, and extra delimiter handling through fi.

properties.claim: The seventeen TeX82 predicates share the expandable if_test command with operands 0 through 16, while fi, else, and or share fi_or_else operands 2, 3, and 4; recovery uses the frozen fi meaning rather than a redefinable control sequence.
preconditions: The exact eight-bit TeX82 primitive profile has been initialized.
No extension-only predicate or delimiter is admitted to the TeX82 classification.
stimulus: Resolve and deliver every TeX82 predicate and delimiter primitive, including a redefinition of the public fi control sequence before incomplete-skip recovery.
Planned semantic minifixture tests/tex82-oracle/scanner-conditionals.tex case classification-aliases observes this property directly.
expected_observations: Canonical command observations use if_test operands 0–16 and fi_or_else operands fi=2, else=3, and or=4.
Inserted recovery fi retains the inaccessible frozen primitive identity.
postconditions: Classification alone neither pushes nor pops a condition frame.
Primitive aliases preserve the same command and operand identity.
equivalence_cases: A primitive token and any control-sequence alias with the same installed meaning have identical command and operand identity.
All predicate names occupy one contiguous if_test operand family, while fi, else, and or remain distinct operands of one fi_or_else family.
recovery_cases: An inserted frozen fi is unaffected by a live fi redefinition.
A delimiter delivered with no live condition is classified normally before extra-delimiter recovery.
Planned recovery minifixture tests/tex82-oracle/scanner-conditionals.tex case frozen-fi-after-public-fi-redefinition observes canonical recovery directly.

properties.claim: Conditions form a stack independent of input and save stacks; push preserves the prior limit, kind, and source line, pop restores them, and limit changes target the initiating frame even when recursive operand expansion has pushed newer frames.
preconditions: The condition stack is empty or contains a well-formed outer frame.
The current source line is known at predicate entry.
stimulus: Enter, complete, and pop nested conditions, including an outer operand whose expansion evaluates and closes an inner condition.
Planned semantic minifixture tests/tex82-oracle/scanner-conditionals.tex case stack-nesting-source-macro-token-list observes this property directly.
expected_observations: Each predicate pushes an evaluating frame with its kind and source line.
True completion changes that exact frame to else; false completion changes it to fi or pops it; fi restores the prior frame.
postconditions: Popping the last frame restores the empty-stack normal limit and zero current condition state.
Input-level pushes/pops and grouping do not own or reorder condition frames.
equivalence_cases: Source, macro, and token-list nesting share the same independent condition-stack order.
A stable frame identity selects the same outer frame whether zero, one, or several recursively evaluated frames temporarily lie above it.
recovery_cases: Recursive evaluation may temporarily place a newer frame above the saved frame without retargeting its limit change.
Job-finalization reporting belongs to the broader final_cleanup contract and is not claimed from §1335 by this shard.
Planned recovery minifixture tests/tex82-oracle/scanner-conditionals.tex case recursive-operand-frame-retargeting observes canonical recovery directly.

properties.claim: pass_text temporarily sets scanner status to skipping, reads only raw commands, balances nested if_test/fi pairs, ignores braces as structure, and stops at the first outer or, else, or fi while preserving the found delimiter for its caller.
preconditions: A live condition has selected a limb that must be skipped.
The prior scanner status and the starting source line are available.
stimulus: Skip text containing expandable macros, braces, nested conditions, inner delimiters, outer control sequences, and an EOF boundary.
Planned semantic minifixture tests/tex82-oracle/scanner-conditionals.tex case skipped-side-effects-and-braces observes this property directly.
expected_observations: Skipped expandable tokens are delivered raw and not expanded, while nested predicates increment and nested fi decrements the local depth.
Scanner status changes to skipping and is restored exactly once around each pass_text invocation.
postconditions: The cursor is immediately after the stopping delimiter and no skipped branch effect has executed.
The independent condition stack is changed only by the caller or by nested-fi cleanup required by §500.
equivalence_cases: Literal braces and control sequences meaning braces are equally inert as grouping operations while skipped.
Skipped source and token-list input use the same raw-command nesting count and stop at the same outer delimiter.
recovery_cases: An outer token during skipping is backed up and recovery inserts frozen fi.
EOF during skipping reports the skip start line before inserted-fi replay.
Planned recovery minifixture tests/tex82-oracle/scanner-conditionals-eof.tex case skipped-child-eof-frozen-fi observes canonical recovery directly.

properties.claim: Boolean and ifcase selection use one nesting-aware skip machine: true booleans wait for else or fi, false booleans find their own else/fi, ifcase skips exactly the requested limbs, and accepted or/else skip through the matching fi before popping.
preconditions: A predicate frame was pushed with evaluating limit before any operands were scanned.
Delimiter legality is compared against the live frame's canonical limit ordering.
stimulus: Evaluate true and false booleans; zero, positive, exhausted, and negative ifcase indices; nested conditions during evaluation and skipping; and every delimiter at evaluating, else, or, fi, and empty-stack limits.
Planned semantic minifixture tests/tex82-oracle/scanner-conditionals.tex case ifcase-zero-positive-negative-boundaries observes this property directly.
expected_observations: False limbs record each stopped delimiter while still evaluating, then common_ending pops on fi or changes the frame to fi on else.
ifcase records each skipped or under evaluating, changes to or only for a selected case, and negative indices continue until else or fi.
Accepted or and else skip remaining limbs without changing the frame limit; fi pops immediately.
postconditions: Exactly one branch is selected and only its effects execute.
After the matching fi, the prior condition frame and limit are restored.
equivalence_cases: Ifcase zero selects the first limb directly, while each positive index selects the identically positioned or-delimited limb after that many skips.
A false boolean ending at else and an exhausted ifcase ending at else share common_ending limit transition and later fi pop behavior.
recovery_cases: An or encountered while seeking a false boolean's else/fi is diagnosed as extra and skipping continues.
A delimiter above an evaluating limit inserts relax; above any completed limit it emits the matching Extra diagnostic and is ignored.
Planned recovery minifixture tests/tex82-oracle/scanner-conditionals.tex case premature-and-extra-delimiters observes canonical recovery directly.

properties.claim: The conditional evaluator dispatches each of the seventeen TeX82 predicate kinds to exactly one canonical operand evaluator; mode and inner predicates query current mode state, ifeof queries a scanned read-stream slot, and iftrue and iffalse return constants.
preconditions: An evaluating frame has been pushed with one TeX82 predicate kind.
Typed mode, box, stream, scanner, and token services expose current state without transferring ownership to the condition stack.
stimulus: Evaluate every predicate kind, including all signed mode families, inner and outer states, open and closed streams, and both constant predicates.
Planned semantic minifixture tests/tex82-oracle/scanner-conditionals.tex case mode-inner-eof-and-constant-truth-table observes this property directly.
expected_observations: Each predicate reaches its unique §501 arm and returns one boolean to the shared branch machine.
Mode tests use absolute mode, ifinner uses the mode sign, ifeof scans one four-bit stream selector, and constant predicates consume no operand.
postconditions: Dispatch does not mutate queried mode or stream state.
Operand-owning predicates consume only the scanner or tokens specified by their dedicated sections.
equivalence_cases: Positive and negative modes of the same family agree for ifvmode, ifhmode, and ifmmode, while only negative modes satisfy ifinner.
Any two stream slots with the same open or closed state give the same ifeof result, independent of slot identity.
recovery_cases: An invalid stream selector completes canonical four-bit scanner recovery before ifeof queries the recovered slot.
A delimiter reached during delegated operand evaluation uses evaluating-limit recovery before dispatch completes.
Planned recovery minifixture tests/tex82-oracle/scanner-conditionals.tex case ifeof-four-bit-selector-recovery observes canonical recovery directly.

properties.claim: Ifnum scans integers and ifdim scans normal dimensions on both sides of one less-than, equality, or greater-than relation, then compares the two canonical values with that relation.
preconditions: An evaluating ifnum or ifdim frame is current.
Integer and normal-dimension scanners commit values before relation scanning.
stimulus: Compare lesser, equal, and greater literal, register, parameter, and internal operands for both integer and dimension families.
Planned semantic minifixture tests/tex82-oracle/scanner-conditionals.tex case ifnum-ifdim-three-relations observes this property directly.
expected_observations: The left operand is retained across relation and right-operand scanning.
A valid other-character relation selects the corresponding signed comparison.
postconditions: Exactly two typed values and one relation are consumed.
The comparison result enters the shared boolean branch machine without mutating either operand source.
equivalence_cases: Literal, radix, register, parameter, and internal integer spellings with equal values produce equal comparison results.
Dimensions expressed in different legal units but resolving to equal scaled points compare equal.
recovery_cases: A missing relation reports Missing = inserted, backs up the nonrelation token, and compares for equality.
Operand scanner recovery completes before relation truth is computed.
Planned recovery minifixture tests/tex82-oracle/scanner-conditionals.tex case missing-relation-inserts-equals observes canonical recovery directly.

properties.claim: Ifodd scans one integer and is true exactly when the canonical signed integer is odd.
preconditions: An evaluating ifodd frame is current.
The integer scanner supplies one canonical signed value.
stimulus: Evaluate zero, positive and negative even values, and positive and negative odd values from literal and internal sources.
Planned semantic minifixture tests/tex82-oracle/scanner-conditionals.tex case ifodd-zero-positive-negative-parity observes this property directly.
expected_observations: Exactly one integer scanner result precedes the boolean branch.
Oddness depends on parity and not on sign or spelling.
postconditions: The scanned source value is unchanged.
The parity result enters the shared boolean branch machine.
equivalence_cases: Positive and negative integers with the same odd magnitude both satisfy ifodd.
Decimal, radix, register, and internal spellings of one integer have identical parity.
recovery_cases: Integer scanner recovery supplies its canonical fallback before parity is tested.
A premature delimiter during integer scanning follows evaluating-limit recovery and then completes the operand.
Planned recovery minifixture tests/tex82-oracle/scanner-conditionals.tex case ifodd-premature-delimiter observes canonical recovery directly.

properties.claim: Ifvoid, ifhbox, and ifvbox scan one eight-bit box register and distinguish null, hlist, and vlist values without consuming or changing the register.
preconditions: An evaluating box predicate frame is current.
The aggregate box query distinguishes absent, horizontal-list, and vertical-list values.
stimulus: Evaluate all three predicates over void, hbox, and vbox registers, including register selectors at the legal boundaries.
The committed command-semantic case box-register-selector-recovery observes the bounded selector gap as a strict xfail linked to umber2-johp.246.
expected_observations: Ifvoid is true only for null; ifhbox and ifvbox are false for null and true only for their matching list type.
One eight-bit register scan precedes one aggregate box-kind query.
postconditions: The tested box register retains the same node list and ownership.
The box-kind result enters the shared boolean branch machine.
equivalence_cases: Empty and nonempty boxes of one list type give the same type-predicate result.
Equivalent register-number spellings select the same box and produce the same truth value.
recovery_cases: An out-of-range register selector completes canonical eight-bit scanner recovery before the box query.
A void register never dereferences a node-list type.
The command-semantic box-register-selector-recovery case pins the first canonical-versus-current branch mismatch and rejects XPASS or changed failure.

cases: selector 256 is replaced by register zero
pinned first mismatch rejects XPASS and changed failure

properties.claim: if and ifcat expand operands and compare normalized character code or category, including noexpand-active handling, while ifx reads both operands raw and compares nonmacro meanings or macro flags plus complete parameter/replacement token texts.
preconditions: Current meanings and immutable macro token texts are available without using allocation identity as semantics.
The scanner status can be temporarily normalized while ifx reads outer meanings.
stimulus: Compare characters, category variants, active characters after noexpand, noncharacter controls, equal/different primitive meanings, and macros varying flags, parameter text, replacement text, and storage identity.
Planned semantic minifixture tests/tex82-oracle/scanner-conditionals.tex case character-category-and-raw-ifx-matrix observes this property directly.
expected_observations: if compares character codes and ifcat compares categories after expanded delivery; noncharacters use the common relax/256 sentinel.
ifx does not expand operands, admits outer controls, and treats macros as equal exactly when command flags and raw token sequences match.
postconditions: Exactly two operands are consumed and the prior scanner status is restored.
Macro reference/storage identity has no effect on ifx equality.
equivalence_cases: Distinct macro allocations containing identical flags and token texts compare equal, while a flag or token-text difference compares unequal.
Character operands produced directly or by expansion compare identically after if and ifcat normalization.
recovery_cases: A delimiter encountered while either operand is being obtained follows evaluating-limit inserted-relax recovery.
A noncharacter operand to if/ifcat is normalized rather than diagnosed.
Planned recovery minifixture tests/tex82-oracle/scanner-conditionals.tex case token-predicate-premature-delimiter observes canonical recovery directly.
